# ghp Provider

Manages the [ghp](https://github.com/goodtune/ghp) secrets engine (vault-plugin-secrets-ghp) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao: its mount, connection config and roles. The plugin must already be registered in the plugin catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ghp = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-ghp"
    }
  }
}

# address and token fall back to VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN.
provider "ghp" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}

variable "ghp_admin_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "ghp_secret_backend" "ghp" {
  path        = "ghp"
  base_url    = "https://ghp.example.com"
  admin_token = var.ghp_admin_token
}

resource "ghp_secret_role" "ci" {
  backend         = ghp_secret_backend.ghp.path
  name            = "ci"
  installation_id = 12345
  repositories    = ["example/app"]
  scopes          = ["contents:read", "pull_requests:write"]
  ttl             = 3600
  max_ttl         = 28800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
